changeSet.author: codex

preConditions.onFailMessage: DIMENSION_DEFINITION_LEGACY_MIGRATION_RETIREMENT_BLOCKED: finish all migration batches and pin every canonical DIMENSION head before deployment
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'modeling_model_spec'::regclass AND conname = 'ck_model_spec_dimension_definition_ref'
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'modeling_dimension_definition_legacy_map'::regclass AND conname = 'fk_dimension_definition_legacy_batch'
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_dimension_definition_legacy_map) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_dimension_definition_migration_batch)
SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec WHERE contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2

SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec WHERE contract_version = 2 AND NOT ( ( model_type = 'DIMENSION' AND dimension_definition_id IS NOT NULL AND dimension_definition_revision IS NOT NULL ) OR ( model_type <> 'DIMENSION' AND dimension_definition_id IS NULL AND dimension_definition_revision IS NULL ) )

changeSet.comment: Remove the completed dimension-definition compatibility migration ledger and make revision-pinned DimensionDefinition ownership mandatory on every canonical DIMENSION head.
changeSet.sql: LOCK TABLE modeling_dimension_definition_legacy_map, modeling_dimension_definition_migration_batch, modeling_model_spec IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE

DO $$ BEGIN IF ( (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_dimension_definition_legacy_map) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_dimension_definition_migration_batch) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec WHERE contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2) + (SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec WHERE contract_version = 2 AND NOT ( (model_type = 'DIMENSION' AND dimension_definition_id IS NOT NULL AND dimension_definition_revision IS NOT NULL) OR (model_type <> 'DIMENSION' AND dimension_definition_id IS NULL AND dimension_definition_revision IS NULL) )) ) <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DIMENSION_DEFINITION_LEGACY_MIGRATION_RETIREMENT_LOCKED_RECHECK_FAILED'; END IF; END $$;
